name: idle-wake
description: RETIRED DIAGNOSTIC, excluded from `all` via wip. A bisect step, written to answer one question rather than to guard a behaviour. It has one stored run and has never been green. Still runnable by name if that investigation is reopened. ORIGINAL NOTE: The earlier confirmation probe, corrected. tmp-idle-wake-probe watched for 'activated on host' after the FORWARD scroll, which never emits it - that marker comes from the REVERSE hop back to an already-resident host. This variant mirrors swipe-scroll-phase up to the reverse scroll, then goes completely quiet for 60s (GATE 1) before sending a single no-op cursor move (GATE 2).

actions.note: GATE 1: 60s of total quiet - no further input of any kind
the wake: a single cursor move, which mutates no app state
GATE 2: if this passes after gate 1 failed, the activation was pending and the cursor move released it
